info.title: package-surface
info.description: Baselines the execution-capable surface of resolved NuGet dependencies. Detects new or changed MSBuild, compiler-extension, source/content, and native package assets.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: PackageSurface shows when a NuGet dependency starts participating in your build in a new way.

options.name: --format
options.description: Report format (default: text).

options.name: --output
options.description: Baseline output path (required by baseline).

options.name: --baseline
options.description: Baseline input path (required by check).

options.name: --strict-content
options.description: Fingerprint present, active build/compiler execution assets (default: off).

options.name: --compiler-api-version
options.description: Set the versioned analyzer compatibility context.

options.name: --project
options.description: Select one project when a solution contains several projects.

options.name: --no-telemetry
options.description:
Suppress the optional activation request for this invocation.
Exit codes:
0  Scan/baseline succeeded, or check passed.
1  Check found a surface or policy difference.
2  Invalid invocation, missing/unsupported input, incomplete analysis, or environment error.
Analysis reads existing restore evidence. It does not restore packages, evaluate MSBuild,
or execute package code. PS007 means analysis is incomplete; reports contain no surface
entries, and baseline files are not replaced. Supported input and safety details:
https://github.com/KeelMatrix/PackageSurface/blob/main/docs/restore-and-baseline-safety.md
Product scope and examples:
https://github.com/KeelMatrix/PackageSurface/blob/main/README.md
Telemetry details:
https://github.com/KeelMatrix/PackageSurface/blob/main/PRIVACY.md
